description: Group-chat page for an online "task job" where a mentor tells the newcomer to deposit money to an admin's personal account to unlock VIP missions, with scarcity pressure and shill testimonials.
rationale: Pay-to-earn task scams use small early payouts and fake testimonials; deposit to a personal account with promised 30% return and limited slots is clearly manipulative.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
